subject.title: refactor(whatsapp): centralize inbound turn admission and history finalization

question: Should WhatsApp callback consumers lose `admission.senderAccess`, `commandAccess`, and `activationAccess` now, or should those redacted projections remain deprecated through an approved compatibility window?
rationale: The architectural refactor is sound, but deciding when an exported callback shape may be removed is a plugin API policy choice that cannot be inferred safely from tests or implementation quality.

options.title: Preserve Deprecated Projections
options.body: Add `turnAdmission` while retaining the three redacted fields as deprecated derived values until the documented removal window.

options.title: Approve Immediate Removal
options.body: Remove the fields now only after documenting tag-history proof that they were never shipped or explicitly accepting the callback compatibility break.

recommendation.title: Preserve Deprecated Projections
recommendation.body: Add `turnAdmission` while retaining the three redacted fields as deprecated derived values until the documented removal window.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest evidence-backed connection to both the WhatsApp ownership refactor and the affected callback surface.
